title: Align component negotiation with mls-extensions #110
description:
mlswg/mls-extensions PR #110 (merged 2026-11-01, closes #102) adds §5 negotiation rules modeled on required_capabilities (RFC 9420 §11.1). Bring mimid in line:

1. Built-ins not listed: support for app_components (0x0001) and safe_aad (0x0002) is implied by app_data_dictionary support; they are not listed, and an entry for either is ignored. mimid currently lists 0x0001 in its LeafNode app_components (decision mimid-1wgh.4.25 reading B, 7ea4456). Stop sending it; ignore it on receipt. Supersede that decision.
2. Absent app_components or safe_aad in a LeafNode = empty list. A LeafNode that does not list a component is treated as not supporting it.
3. Leaf validation (part of RFC 9420 §7.3, wherever a LeafNode is validated): a LeafNode in a group is invalid if the GroupContext app_components or safe_aad lists a component the LeafNode's corresponding list does not. Checked against the GroupContext of the validating epoch; proposal and UpdatePath LeafNodes are checked against the pre-Commit GroupContext. Does not apply to KeyPackage LeafNodes before Add (rule 5 catches those).
4. Join: a client MUST NOT join a group whose GroupContext requires a component it does not support.
5. Commit: invalid if the resulting epoch's GroupContext requires a component that a member of the resulting epoch does not list in its LeafNode.
6. State tied to list: a GroupContext is invalid if app_data_dictionary has an entry for a component (other than 0x0001/0x0002) not listed in app_components. Apply at group creation, to the resulting epoch of each Commit, and to the GroupContext a joiner receives. Judge by resulting epoch, so one Commit may require a component and set its state in any proposal order.
7. content_media_types: when a group creator includes it in the GroupContext, the GroupContext must also list it in app_components.

Already matching: Safe AAD components listed in both app_components and safe_aad. Clients need not advertise every implemented component (kkohbrok on #102).

First audit which of 3-6 mimid already enforces; unverified. Tests need an independent oracle (spec-derived vectors or cross-check against another implementation), not mimid's own output.

Related: mimid-1wgh.37.35 (wg question, answered by #110).
